@musicaamazigh @JohnMashey And as John has written about a lot previously, the Rashomon Effect and even false memories.

It was perfect storm in the (necessary and mostly very good) #MeToo movement - allege & publicize. Media was quite happy to go along, doing damage here.

@n8r0n74 Yeah, tricky. None seemed 'right' to me, but that didn't mean they wouldn't turn out true. On and off I thought I'd have to eat my words. (Promise, I'm not an apologist for abuse!) But I want truth, too. And I won't forfeit my critical thinking for also thinking #MeToo important.
